title: Comment "Week" and I'll send you the full prompt chain 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to plan
description: Comment "Week" and I'll send you the full prompt chain 👇 What happens when you ask ChatGPT to plan your entire week so you stop wasting time? I tried this and it gave me back hours I didn't even know I was losing. Here's how: Say: "Ask me 7 questions about everything I have going on this week so you can understand my work, my goals, and what's actually stressing me out." Answer all the questions. Then say: "Now based on these answers, build me a full hour by hour schedule that protects my deep work, batches my small tasks together, and makes sure nothing important slips." ChatGPT gives you a full schedule that'll blow your mind. Here's the most important part: Go to Apps, search for Google Calendar, and connect it. Then say: "Now go put this entire schedule into my calendar for me with reminders for each block." ChatGPT fills every slot on your calendar automatically while you do nothing. #chatgpt #ai #chatgptprompts #productivity #timemanagement
